pages.subtitle: Why FFmpeg Remains the Unsung Backbone of Every High-Throughput Video Pipeline

pages.title: 01 // THE FANCY WRAPPER
pages.content:
AI generates the prompt. React draws the DOM. FFmpeg does the dirty work.

Underneath fancy AI video generators and cloud dashboards sits a 25-year-old C program inside a Unix terminal. When React draws frame canvases and AI voice synthesizes raw PCM audio, FFmpeg combines, compresses, and encodes h264 bytes at 60fps.

pages.title: 02 // PIPES, NOT DISKS
pages.content:
Writing temporary PNG files to disk explodes I/O, spikes server memory, and doubles cloud bills.

Systems engineers open stdout pipes from Chrome directly into stdin of FFmpeg. Raw YUV420p bytes flow through RAM without disk writes or temporary files.
pages.code:
cat frames/*.yuv | ffmpeg -f rawvideo -pixel_format yuv420p \
  -video_size 1920x1080 -framerate 60 -i pipe:0 \
  -c:v libx264 -pix_fmt yuv420p output.mp4

pages.title: 03 // ZERO MEMORY LEAK & HIGH THROUGHPUT
pages.content: While JS frameworks come and go, FFmpeg has been crunching bytes silently for 25 years. Respect the heavy lifter.
